The '''Kibnon''' were a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distantly related to the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]]. With six [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] and two bulbous [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] on [[Ommatophora|stalks]], they had an exotic appearance to many species. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Kibnon [[Sinthia Pulchatt]] operated as a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while other Kibnon were found on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Tresidiss]] and [[Ando/Legends|Ando]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Kibnon were an [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that were distant relatives of the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]]. They had a slender thorax and abdomen, and four [[Limb/Legends|legs]], which provided stability. In addition to these limbs, the Kibnon also had two arms, which were typically held close to their bodies. They were green in coloration, and could grow to a height of 2.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], as demonstrated by the Kibnon [[Sinthia Pulchatt]].<ref name="GG7" />

The Kibnon had roughly triangular heads, with two bulbous, [[Ommatophora|stalk-mounted]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] projecting from the top surface. A thin antenna grew from each side of their heads, which could point either up<ref name="GG7" /> or down.<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> Two small mandibles grew by their [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]]. The combination of these features made the Kibnon appear exotic to many other species.<ref name="GG7" />

==Kibnon in the galaxy==
[[File:Kibnon.png|thumb|left|250px|A Kibnon on Tresidiss]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Kibnon Sinthia Pulchatt operated as a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] merchant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="GG7" /> located in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations 2005">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Groomed for the occupation from a young age, Pulchatt operated out of the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] settlement, serving as a liaison between her boss and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], a local [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. She was a regular at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]], often looking for new spice customers.<ref name="GG7" />

During this period, another Kibnon visited [[Tresidiss]], an Outer Rim planet notorious for its [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]]-operated [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] halls and [[Casino/Legends|casinos]]. This Kibnon was accompanied by a diminutive [[Unidentified stalk-eyed species|stalk-eyed alien]].<ref name="GG11" /> Kibnon were also among the numerous species&mdash;including [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Givin/Legends|Givins]], and [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]]&mdash;that [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] experimented on while on the planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. Evazan sought to discover a way to become immortal using a mind-transference machine, but his experiments were thwarted when one of his patients attempted to assassinate him using a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].<ref name="Doctor Death: The Tale of Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba">{{StoryCite|story=Doctor Death: The Tale of Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kibnon were first described in the [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]'', published in [[1993]]. They were illustrated by [[Mike Vilardi]].<ref name="GG7" />
